note: Alloc and byte budgets for the signing path (issue #107). Baselines measured 2026-09-24 on INTEL XEON PLATINUM 8573C (2 vCPU), go1.27.1 linux/amd64, with ~40% headroom so a Go minor bump or a shared CI runner does not flake. ns/op is never gated. Raising a budget requires a commit body that says which change increased the cost and why it is acceptable. Never lower a budget without a fresh measurement.
